name: codex-claude-bridge
summary: 本机 MCP 连接器，让 Codex 分派、审查并验收 Claude Code 工作。
summaryEnglish: A local MCP bridge and Codex plugin for Claude Code orchestration, event-driven handoffs, reasoning profiles and verification evidence reuse.

onboardingSkill.name: codex-claude-bridge
onboardingSkill.installCommand: npx skills add lordfine/codex-claude-bridge --skill codex-claude-bridge --agent codex

limitations: Third-party provider reasoning support remains unverified.
Existing running Claude sessions may require an optional restart for settings.
Active Codex writers can delay automatic resumption.
Orca unified quotas and acceptance merging are not integrated.
No guaranteed token or monetary savings.
